metadata.title: Where I've been · your world map
metadata.description: Mark the countries you've visited and see what percentage of the world you've explored, and how you compare to everyone else.

common.toggleTheme: Switch between light and dark mode

explorer.authReason: {count, plural, one {Save the country you marked and compare it with your friends.} other {Save the # countries you marked and compare them with your friends.}}

statsRail.emptyDetail: Tap the countries on the map where you've been. At three we'll show you your world percentile.
statsRail.confirmReset: {count, plural, one {Delete it, are you sure?} other {Delete all #, are you sure?}}
statsRail.benchmarkNote: Compared against preloaded public data ({sources}). Replaced with real user averages once there's enough of them.

start.headline: {count, plural, one {# country marked} other {# countries marked}}
start.detail: Keep marking. At 3 countries we'll show you how you compare with everyone else.

firstPercentile.headline: You've already visited more countries than {beats}% of the world
firstPercentile.detail: With {count} countries you're above the global average, which is around 5.

aboveAverage.headline: You're in the top {topPercent}% most traveled on the planet
aboveAverage.detailWithContinent: Your most explored continent is {continent}, {coveragePercent}% covered.
aboveAverage.detailWithoutContinent: A third of people have never left their own country.

top5.headline: {count} countries put you in the top {topPercent}% worldwide
top5.detail: The 95th percentile in wealthy countries starts around 25 countries. You've already passed it.

top1.headline: Top 1% of the planet
top1.detail: Passing 50 countries puts you above 99% of people. You're at {count}.

legend.headline: {count} countries. {remaining} to go
legend.detail: At this point you're easier to find by scale than by country.

peerComparison.compareCta: Compare with people from your city and your age

usersAverage.ahead: You're {count, plural, one {# country} other {# countries}} ahead of {country}'s average
usersAverage.behind: You're {count, plural, one {# country} other {# countries}} short of {country}'s average
usersAverage.detail: The average there is {average} countries, based on {sampleSize} registered people.

countryTail.headline: You're {tail} most traveled in {country}
countryTail.detail: Estimated: in {country} only {share}% reached {threshold} countries, and you're at {count}. {source}

thresholdOnly.headline: In {country}, only {share}% reached {threshold} countries
thresholdOnly.detailWithCount: You're at {count}. {remaining, plural, one {You need # more} other {You need # more}} to join that group. {source}

noData.headline: We don't have data for {country} yet
noData.detail: Worldwide, {neverTraveled}% never left their country and only {tenOrMore}% reached ten or more. {supabaseNote}
noData.supabaseNote: Once enough people there are registered, we'll swap this for the real average.

subdivisionDialog.loadFailed: We couldn't load the map for {label}.
subdivisionDialog.mapAriaLabel: Map of {label}. Tap one to mark it.
subdivisionDialog.notCountedNote: {label} don't count toward the 195-country total — they're their own tally.

subdivisionEntries.heading: In detail
subdivisionEntries.help: Mark provinces, states, or regions inside a country too. They have their own tally and don't count toward the 195 total — they're for the countries you really know, not just passed through.
subdivisionEntries.removeWithData: Remove {country} and everything marked inside it

accountDialog.title: Your account
accountDialog.usernameHint: It's how your friends find you.
accountDialog.usernamePattern: Between 3 and 20 characters: letters, numbers, or underscore.
accountDialog.homeCountryHint: Used to compare you with your peers.
accountDialog.publicHint: Anyone with the link can see my map. Turn this off and only your accepted friends can see it.

errors.copyFailed: We couldn't copy the link. Copy it by hand.

accountDialog.inviteDetail: Everyone who joins through your link gets connected with you and shows up on the leaderboard.

importDialog.title: Import from Google Maps

errors.noLocations: We couldn't find any locations in that file. Make sure it's the Timeline one.
errors.readFailed: We couldn't read the file. It has to be a .json from the Google export.

importDialog.addedCountries: {count, plural, one {We added # country} other {We added # countries}}
importDialog.readSummaryWithAlready: We read {points} locations, and {already} of the countries were already marked.
importDialog.intro: Google doesn't let other apps read your location history, so you have to bring it over by hand. It takes a minute, but after that the map fills itself in.

steps.second: Check only Location History (Timeline) and request the export.
steps.third: When the email arrives, unzip it and look for the .json files.
steps.fourth: Upload them here. You can select several at once.

importDialog.privacyNote: The file is read right here, in your browser. It's never uploaded to a server or kept anywhere — only the resulting countries are saved.

authDialog.title: Save your progress
authDialog.checkInbox: We sent an email to <email>{emailAddress}</email> to confirm the account. Open it and you'll come back here with everything saved.
authDialog.defaultReason: With an account your map follows you across devices and you can compare with your friends.
authDialog.wantAccount: I want to create an account

errors.alreadyRegistered: That email already has an account. Try signing in.
errors.passwordTooShort: The password has to be at least 8 characters.
errors.generic: We couldn't complete that step. Try again.

referralWelcome.title: You were invited
referralWelcome.invitedByName: <name>{inviterName}</name> invited you to compare your map
referralWelcome.invitedByUnknown: Someone invited you to compare your map
referralWelcome.detail: If you connect, you'll both be able to see how many countries each of you has and show up together on the friends leaderboard. If you'd rather not, keep exploring without connecting — your map stays yours either way.

shareCardDialog.title: Share your map
shareCardDialog.generateFailed: We couldn't generate the image. Try again.
shareCardDialog.noWebShare: Your browser can't share files, so we downloaded it instead — the caption with your link is copied, ready to paste.
shareCardDialog.downloadedWithCopy: Image downloaded. The caption with your link is copied, ready to paste.

shareCard.inviteQuestionNamed: {name} has visited {count} countries. What about you? Come find out!

countrySearch.ariaLabel: Search for a country by name

savePromptCard.headline: {count, plural, one {You've got # country marked} other {You've got # countries marked}}
savePromptCard.detail: If you close without an account, this only lives in this browser. Save it and compare with your friends.

worldMap.mapAriaLabel: World map. Tap a country to mark it as visited.

globeMap.ariaLabel: Globe. Drag to rotate it and tap a country to mark it.
